The *Bhājanapālakattheraapadāna* is a verse text located in the Therāpadāna section of the Pali Khuddaka Nikāya, designated in modern cataloging as Tha Ap 234 [SuttaCentral]. Falling within the collection's late biographical verse strata, the text records the biographical verses associated with the elder Bhājanapālaka [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral catalogs translations of the text in five languages [SuttaCentral].
